eligibility.firstYear: Passed 10+2 (HSC) or equivalent with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with Chemistry/Biotech/CS/IT with minimum 45% aggregate marks (40% for Reserved Categories / PwD of Maharashtra). Valid score in MHT-CET 2026 or JEE Main Paper 1 is mandatory.
eligibility.directSecondYear: Passed Diploma in Engineering & Technology with minimum 45% marks (40% for reserved category) OR B.Sc. degree with Mathematics with minimum 45% marks.
eligibility.mtech: Valid GATE score + B.E./B.Tech in relevant branch with min 50% (45% reserved).

quotaDistribution.stateCapMerit: 65% seats filled through Centralized Admission Process (CAP) of State CET Cell Maharashtra
quotaDistribution.allIndiaJEE: 20% seats based on All India JEE Main Paper-1 Merit
quotaDistribution.institutionalManagement: 15% Institutional / Management Quota based on merit guidelines

documentsRequired: School / Junior College Leaving / Transfer Certificate (TC/LC)
Maharashtra State Domicile Certificate & Nationality Certificate
Caste Certificate, Caste Validity & Non-Creamy Layer (for OBC/VJ/NT/SBC valid up to March 2027)
Income Certificate issued by Tahsildar (for EBC/TFWS/Govt Scholarships)
Aadhar Card copy and 5 recent passport-size colored photographs
stepsToApply: Step 1: Register on Maharashtra State CET Cell CAP Admissions portal (mahacet.org).
Step 2: Complete Document E-Scrutiny or Physical Scrutiny at designated Scrutiny Centers.
Step 3: Check Provisional & Final Merit List ranking.
Step 4: Fill College Option Form putting ISBM College of Engineering (Choice Code: 6622) as top preference.
Step 5: On seat allotment in CAP Round, report to ISBM COE Admission Cell with original documents & fees.

faq.q: What is the DTE Code for ISBM College of Engineering?
faq.a: The official DTE Institute Code for ISBM College of Engineering, Pune is 6622. Use Choice Code 6622 during MHT-CET CAP option form filling.

faq.q: What is the fee structure for Computer Engineering at ISBM COE?
faq.a: The annual academic fee for Computer Engineering is approximately ₹1,08,000 for Open/General category. For OBC/EBC students with income < 8 LPA, it is ₹65,500. Under AICTE TFWS scheme, tuition fee is 100% free (₹23,000 total). For SC/ST students, it is only ₹4,000. Hostel & mess charges are around ₹70,000/year (3-sharing).

faq.q: Which university is ISBM College of Engineering affiliated to?
faq.a: ISBM College of Engineering is permanently approved by AICTE, New Delhi, recognized by DTE Govt. of Maharashtra, and affiliated to Savitribai Phule Pune University (SPPU).

faq.q: What are the cutoff percentiles for Computer Engineering and AI & Data Science?
faq.a: For the recent MHT-CET CAP rounds, Computer Engineering closing percentile was approx 88.5%ile (General), 84.0%ile (OBC), and 72.0%ile (SC/ST). For AI & Data Science, it was approx 86.2%ile (General) and 81.5%ile (OBC).

faq.q: How are placements at ISBM College of Engineering?
faq.a: ISBM COE recorded an 88.6% placement rate with the highest package reaching ₹18.5 LPA (Amazon) and an average package of ₹6.4 LPA. Top recruiters include Amazon, Capgemini, TCS, Infosys, Cognizant, Wipro, and Tata Motors.
ISBM College of Engineering is located at ISBM Knowledge Campus, S. No. 44/1, 44/1/2, Nande Village, Pashan-Sus Road, Pune - 412115 (close to Hinjawadi IT Park).
